# Pose at obs 75:
# X = 0.7071, Y = 1.7071, heading = 0 deg (north).
# Let us check table leg bottom positions in obs 75:
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0075.png")

# Table is dark brown around x in [60, 210], y in [300, 380]
# Find feet of the table:
# Front-left leg, front-right leg, back-left leg, back-right leg
mask_table = (img[:,:,2] > 90) & (img[:,:,2] < 150) & (img[:,:,1] > 40) & (img[:,:,1] < 80) & (img[:,:,0] < 40)
# Let us isolate the table region x in [50, 220], y in [290, 390]
submask = np.zeros_like(mask_table)
submask[290:390, 50:220] = mask_table[290:390, 50:220]
y_t, x_t = np.where(submask)
print(f"Table bbox in obs 75: x=[{x_t.min()}, {x_t.max()}], y=[{y_t.min()}, {y_t.max()}]")

# Let us find the bottom row of each leg:
for x_col in range(50, 220):
    col_ys = np.where(submask[:, x_col])[0]
    if len(col_ys) > 0 and col_ys.max() > 340:
        pass

# Find columns with maximum y:
max_ys = [np.where(submask[:, x])[0].max() if np.any(submask[:, x]) else 0 for x in range(submask.shape[1])]
legs = []
for x in range(60, 210):
    if max_ys[x] > 345:
        legs.append((x, max_ys[x]))

# Group into connected legs:
leg_clusters = []
curr = []
for pt in legs:
    if not curr or pt[0] == curr[-1][0] + 1:
        curr.append(pt)
    else:
        leg_clusters.append(curr)
        curr = [pt]
if curr:
    leg_clusters.append(curr)

for idx, leg in enumerate(leg_clusters):
    xs = [p[0] for p in leg]
    ys = [p[1] for p in leg]
    print(f"Leg {idx+1}: x_range=[{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], max_y={max(ys)}")
'
